answer: Yesterday's horizon, this morning's wharf, and a tundra that never happened: read the file and the farm gives itself away. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. A mask waits 10 days after paying 90 POA; a farm waits 10 days for each mask after paying 41760 POA. I would bet my own seat on Pewter trimmer silver mark poured at the assay table, because each silver is a measured pewter yield plus a pewterer's signature is public and anyone can check it.
